title: 乐檬零售 AGI · 连接配置
description: 填入你的乐檬零售 AGI 个人访问令牌（Lemon Personal Token）即可开始使用。令牌仅保存在本机 ~/.workbuddy 目录下，不会上传到 WorkBuddy 或任何第三方服务器。
description_en: Enter your Lemon AGI personal access token to get started. The token is stored only on this machine under ~/.workbuddy and is never uploaded to WorkBuddy or any third party.
docLabel: 如何获取乐檬零售 AGI Token？
docLabel_en: How to get a Lemon AGI token?

fields.label: Access Token
fields.placeholder: 以 pt_ 开头的个人访问令牌，在乐檬 AGI 平台个人中心生成
fields.placeholder_en: A personal access token starting with pt_, generated in the Lemon AGI platform
fields.description: 用于访问乐檬 AGI 业务能力的个人访问令牌（Lemon Personal Token），已绑定对应账套。
fields.description_en: Personal access token used to access Lemon AGI business abilities, bound to a specific account book.
